verdict.rationale: Algolia's search analytics docs name the exact metrics the story asks for: popular searches, no-results searches, and click-through rates. They also document period comparison mode, cross-index inclusion, and CSV/XLSX export, and a community user independently praises the analytics for tying queries to purchases. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the no-result and click-through views specifically, and docs on what click-event instrumentation is needed for click-through metrics to populate.
